documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that Baheti Recycling achieved strong performance in FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores, driven by improved operational efficiency and margin expansion. The company is expanding its furnace infrastructure to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27, raising total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually. Furthermore, management highlighted an entry into higher-margin aluminum wire rod products through a new plant investment in Dahegam, targeting significant revenue potential across two phases. Management remains optimistic about industry demand tailwinds stemming from global primary aluminum supply disruptions and government policy support. Management stated that FY26 was a strong year, having surpassed their revenue guidance by 12% with PAT growth exceeding 15% of guided levels.

guidance.claim: The company targets to ramp up capacity utilization to full capacity by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod project will increase production to 25,000 tons and add another 250-odd crores in revenue.
guidance.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management is more than hopeful of reaching a 4-digit revenue figure in the financial year.
guidance.quote: I'm more than hopeful that we'll reach somewhere around 4-digit in this financial alone.

guidance.claim: Management expects utilization for Phase 1 of the wire rod division to reach around 70-odd percentage in FY28.
guidance.quote: FY28 will be reaching somewhere around 70-odd percentage.

guidance.claim: The company closed FY26 having surpassed its stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against guidance.
guidance.quote: FY26 has been a good year for us. We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are confidently positioned to exceed a revenue milestone of ₹1,200 Crore by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, pushing customers toward reliable secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that domestic scrap is much more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir, as on date, domestic scrap is much expensive than imported scrap, number one.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand and government policy tailwinds as well as global industry dynamics favor secondary recycling aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that domestic scrap is roughly 7-8% more expensive.
demand_outlook.quote: No, no not that much, to be very honest. We have not compared, but you can say 7-8% would be expensive.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, creating real pressure on availability.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project will require a maximum of 5 crores for putting up the furnace and all.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar plant and electrical furnaces will bring total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually.
capex_expansion.quote: With this addition, our total installed capacity will stand to 38,000 tons annually.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT, generating between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 scaling to 25,000 MT has a revenue potential reaching ₹500 Crores a year from this division.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity has reached 38,000 MT with five more furnaces lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for commissioning in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of production increased by 15% due to fuel prices and was passed on to the selling price.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%. But ultimately, it has been diverted or it has been passed to our selling price, as simple as that.

margins_costs.claim: The captive solar plant running by the end of May 2026 will directly cut power costs on electric furnaces, with margin benefits starting from Q2 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, company’s actively focused on Reducing the debt and improving the key financial ratio.

capital_allocation.quote: We also raised ₹7.48 Crores through a Preferential Allotment to keep working capital healthy as volumes grow.
